title: Volume 1 Chapter 3: Pedicure 4
content: “Let’s get started.”
“Okay!”
Sayori extended her toes toward me, showing off her beautiful legs without reservation.
Well, even though she had changed into a swimsuit, the task remained the same.
Instead of kneeling on the floor like before, I sat across from Sayori and placed her feet on my lap.
To avoid getting dirt from the shavings on my knees, I laid down a spare cloth.
While it was somewhat easier than working close to the floor, doing work on someone else’s feet was inherently a high-difficulty task.
Sayori was sitting across from me, stretching her feet out toward me.
“Is your position okay?”
I asked just to check.
“Thanks! But I’m fine!”
“If it gets tough, just let me know.”
Even sitting with her legs straight out, Sayori didn’t seem to mind. Her body was probably quite flexible.
As I applied the grinder to her nails, Sayori seemed to have gotten used to it, as she didn’t make any strange noises.
She fiddled with her smartphone while mumbling something to herself.
“Hmm… If I want to make sure it doesn’t get overshadowed by the swimsuit, I should go with a vivid color… But maybe going for something more elegant would work too? What do you think?”
“I’m not sure yet…”
I was thinking too, but I didn’t feel like I could keep up with Sayori’s sense.
“I’ll paint whatever you want, so think it over.”
“Anything!? Really anything!?”
“Just not anything too advanced, okay…?”
There are various types of nails.
What I was applying to Sayori were simple polishes, but if I could eventually handle gel nails and airbrush nails, I would be able to express myself in even more diverse ways.
As I filed Sayori’s nails, I thought about that.
After finishing the initial polishing, I applied the base coat, followed by the main polish. Although I was flustered by her in a swimsuit, from here on, it was a simple task of applying the paint.
Sayori shook her head, happily watching as the color was applied to her nails.
“Hey, Azuma-kun, if I fall, will the polish chip or peel off?”
“I think it should be fine since I’ll protect it with a top coat… But first, don’t fall.”
“You tend to fall a lot at the pool, right?”
“No, that’s not true…”
How could she be so restless?
“Well, depending on how you fall, it could chip. The top coat isn’t infallible.”
“Hmm… What should I do? I can’t fix it myself.”
“So just don’t fall—”
“Right! If you come with me to the shoot, that solves everything!”
“Huh!?”
As usual, she was coming up with ideas from angles I hadn’t even considered.
“Exactly! If I chip my nails, you can fix them on the spot, right?”
“Sure, I could do that…”
For emergency fixes during the shoot, a small detail brush would suffice.
“Is it really okay for an outsider to be at the shoot?”
“I’m not an outsider! I’m a legitimate part of the team!”
“Don’t say it like you’re a dedicated nail artist.”
“I am dedicated!”
“Is that a certainty—”
Oh no. At this rate, I could see myself being pushed into it.
Besides— I genuinely found it enjoyable to care for Sayori’s nails. The act of applying the glittery pink polish that matched her swimsuit to her nails was exciting.
That was probably because it was a process of creating something that had never existed before.
Transforming her ideals into a clear form was incredibly fun.
“I’ll talk to Mio-chan—the editor—about it! Are you free next Sunday?”
“Ah, right… the shoot is next week.”
“Yeah! There’s no time!”
“We need to decide what kind of nails to do quickly.”
That said, I could probably finish both the manicure and pedicure in under two hours now.
“Alright, it’s done.”
I finished applying the top coat to both feet, completing Sayori’s pedicure.
Her feet had become quite flashy. With the swimsuit being glittery pink, she would surely stand out on the beach.
“Wow! It’s so pretty! This might be good enough!”
“Wait, it’s just a trial paint…”
“Can I take a picture!? It’s okay, right!?”
“Do whatever you want.”
While I cleaned up the shavings, Sayori stretched her legs out and started a little photoshoot.
“Make sure to decide what you’ll paint before the actual shoot.”
“Okay!”
Watching Sayori happily take pictures, I couldn’t help but smile.
“…You really do love nails, don’t you?”
I ended up saying it without thinking.
“Yeah! I do!”
“Why do you love them so much?”
“I mentioned it before, but when my hands look pretty and stylish, it boosts my mood, don’t you think?”
“Is that so?”
“I find myself staring at other people’s hands without realizing it. Whether they’re girls or boys!”
Sayori smiled widely.
“I think I just love hands! So I want to put effort into them and make them how I like!”
“Loving hands, huh.”
I had never thought about that.
I looked closely at my own hands. Since I don’t go out much, they’re pale and bony, and they can’t compare to Sayori’s model-like hands.
They didn’t seem beautiful or functional at all.
“I don’t really like my hands that much.”
“Really!? Why not!?”
Sayori’s eyes widened in disbelief.
Not everyone in the world has self-esteem as high as Sayori’s.

“When I build models, I can’t help but mess up. I break parts, over-file them. I spill paint when brush painting or doing panel lining, and I mix colors wrong—no matter how carefully I try to work, I always end up failing.”
“Isn’t that just because you were a beginner?”
“I still mess up often.”
I wondered why I was so clumsy.
I wished my hands could be faster, more accurate, and more precise. I often thought it would be great if my hands were like machines—then I could create the ideal models as much as I wanted.
And I could give Sayori the nails she wanted right away—
“I get compliments from everyone, but I’m still clumsy… So I don’t really like my hands.”
“I like yours.”
Sayori moved closer.
As always, she was right next to me. Before I could take a step back, my hand was enveloped in something warm.
Sayori took my hand in both of hers.
“I like Azuma-kun’s hands!”
“Wha—”
“Because they’re the hands that did my nails for the first time! They’re the hands that created my first nails, so there’s no way they’re clumsy!”
Sayori’s hands were slightly warm.
Was it because she was a dragon? Or was it because she was saying something embarrassing?
“C-Close…”
“Today, you did my pedicure, and I’m sure you’ll create lots of wonderful things in the future! There are definitely many things that can only be done with Azuma-kun’s hands!”
Sayori squeezed my hand tightly.
“I like these hands! They have to be these hands! I really love Azuma-kun’s hands!”
“Ugh.”
Don’t say things that sound like a confession.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Kf0IeBk.jpeg
No, that’s not it. She’s just talking about nails!
“So you have to take good care of your hands! Got it!? I won’t let go of this hand until you understand!”
“Okay, okay…”
Having my hand held by a girl in a swimsuit was making my heart race.
Breathless, I nodded repeatedly in response to Sayori’s words, and she seemed satisfied and finally let go of my hand.
“Alright!”
Not “alright.” I thought I was going to die.
Sayori nodded vigorously, looking pleased.
I continued to be troubled by the close distance of the gal.
What to paint for the shoot remained a homework assignment.
I confirmed that I could paint a beautiful pedicure, and for today, we decided to call it a day.
My dad had also told me to be mindful of Sayori’s curfew.
In the garage, Sayori was eagerly putting her uniform back on. I had been flustered when she took it off, but seeing her put it back on was equally embarrassing.
She was just wearing a swimsuit under her uniform! Why did it feel so strange!?
“Ah, it’s Karla.”
As I averted my gaze, feeling awkward about watching her change, Sayori was looking at her phone.
It seemed she had received a call.
“Sorry, Azuma-kun, can I take this call for a second!?”
“Ah, sure.”
I thought it might be the editor again, but the name she was showing was someone else.
Well, I figured that a gal probably had a wide circle of friends and was frequently on the phone with them, unlike me.
—Or was that a prejudice?
“Hello, Karla? Did you see the pedicure I sent? Isn’t it super cute!? I was thinking of bringing it to the shoot next time—huh?”
It seemed she was talking to someone she had sent the pedicure photo to.
From her tone, it sounded like it was a friend.
“Wait… Karla!? You want me to do yours too…? No, no, no! He’s my nail artist! Hey, are you listening!? Karla! Wait! Don’t ignore me!”
She seemed to be getting all worked up.
Huh? A friend—right?
“Seriously, you should think about your own hands… Hello!? Hello!? Ugh! Seriously, she just hung up on me!”
She was showing her emotions openly.
Now that I think about it, I don’t recall ever seeing Sayori angry. Well, it felt more like she was surprised by the other person’s rudeness than actually angry.
She had always given off an image of someone who smiled at everyone.
Could it be that she was someone who could show her true self to that kind of person? If so, that must be what a true friend is.
It seemed the call had ended, and Sayori was staring blankly at her smartphone for a moment.
“Um… Sorry, Azuma-kun?”
“What’s wrong?”
This was rare. Sayori was speaking to me apologetically.
“If it’s okay with you, I’d like to ask you something—but honestly, I’d be happier if you just said no…”
“What is it? Just say it clearly.”
It was truly unusual for Sayori, who usually spoke directly, to hesitate like this.
“That call was from Karla, a friend of mine… She’s a model friend I met on a shoot…”
“I see.”
A model friend. She must have met her on the set.
“She’s been having a hard time with nails too… Apparently, her dedicated nail artist just retired…”
“Is your friend also a demi-human?”
“Yeah. She is.”
“Well, if it’s just one more person—”
To be honest, there probably weren’t many nail challenges tougher than dealing with dragon nails.
“Is that really okay!? I think Karla is already planning to push her way in!”
“Sayori, you pushed your way in too.”
“I’m different!”
Sayori, who had been quite pushy herself, seemed to be flustered now that her friend was the same way.
Speaking of which, I hadn’t mentioned the nail situation in class because I was worried about being taken over. Am I surprisingly possessive?
Honestly, I didn’t mind one more person joining.
“It’ll be a good experience, and if it’s just Sayori’s friend, I’ll give it a try.”
“Really!? But, um, Karla is—”
Sayori seemed to hesitate about whether to say it.
“Because Karla has four arms, you know!?”
Now that I think about it, there was that fashion magazine with Sayori’s picture in it.
There was a demi-human model with blue skin and four arms.
I hadn’t really looked closely, but could it have been her?
Four arms. Simply put, that meant double the amount of work for nail care.
“Well, I guess it’ll work out somehow.”
I encouraged Sayori, who was on the verge of tears.
I kept thinking about what kind of nail designs would suit a woman with four arms.
“Oh! Azuma-kun is already thinking about Karla! I haven’t introduced her yet! But Azuma-kun is mine! He’s my exclusive nail artist!”
And so, Sayori continued to show her possessiveness while crying.
